shared_context.label: T_{n,j}

shared_context.content: For the same n and j, define H_{n,j}(t) := F_n(T_{n,j}(t)).
shared_context.label: H_{n,j}

strategy_summary: Analytic monotonicity: define the translated function H_{n,j}(t) = F_n((j+t)/n), compute its derivative by the chain rule, prove that derivative is nonpositive on the unit interval, and then pull the inequality back to the original x-variable.
